Method of Attack: The installer downloads and runs the RedLine Stealer from a remote server. This deceitful strategy attempts to fool users into thinking they have successfully installed a real ChatGPT program
Impacted Systems: Windows desktop versions spanning from the October 2018 Update – 1809 to the October 2022 Update – 22H2
Attack Vector: The attackers used BatLoader disguised as MSIX Windows App Installer packages. Victims who searched for 'chatbpt' on Google were routed to a bogus ChatGPT download page
